name: take_screenshot
description: Capture an empirical desktop screenshot on Flowork OS. Saves the optimized capture to $HOME/Pictures/Screenshots/ (or /dev/shm for ultra-fast RAM) and automatically emits it to the active Mr. Flow chat stream.

filename.description: Optional custom filename or prefix (e.g. 'audit_kernel.png'). Defaults to timestamped name.

target.description: Capture target: 'full' for whole display (default), or 'active' for focused window.

compress.description: Compress and optimize screenshot dimensions to avoid prompt and token bloat. Defaults to true.
